notes: Os Esquilos: the old farmhouse restaurant deep in the Tijuca forest, famous for long Sunday lunches. Restyled 2026-11-17 from Esme's photos. Outside: the low colonial house (mossy terracotta roof, cream plaster, white columns, an azulejo veranda with a gallery wall) and its stone-flagged courtyard of parasol tables. Inside: the dining room (cream walls, rust-red sash windows, a dark central post, red-cushioned booths, carved chairs, copper pans, a kitchen hatch with a little wood stove). Two states (start, full) x three looks (day, rain, night), plus five celebration layers per look. No lettering or logo: the name is the map tooltip. Bases ship without stickers or Esme.

celebrationRule: Each WHOLE goal finished lays the next celebration piece, in order (1 feast table, 2 lanterns, 3 flowers and mementos, 4 the roast, 5 the cake), in BOTH scenes, and puts its goal sticker in the next free goal slot (lowest 'order'). Draw the start base, then celebration layers 1..n for the current look (each layer holds only the pixels it changes). After the fifth goal the feast is fully laid; goals 6+ only add stickers. 'full' (the Sunday feast) already contains all five pieces plus the crowd, the friends at the feast table and the band.
